title: [SMM India Domestic Market Weekly Review] India's Domestic Steel Market Remains Under Pressure
dek: Shanghai Metals Market's weekly review says India's domestic steel market remains under pressure.
summary: According to Shanghai Metals Market's weekly review, India's domestic steel market remains under pressure. The publisher's excerpt does not give price levels, volumes or the causes of the weakness.
whyItMatters: Continued softness in the domestic market could weigh on mill realisations and margins in the near term.
implications: Buyers may find room to negotiate, while producers could face pressure to adjust list prices or production; specific figures are not provided.
